arguments.Code: using UnityEngine;using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation;internal class CommandScript:IRunCommand{public void Execute(ExecutionResult result){foreach(var v in Object.FindObjectsByType<VehicleController>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)){result.Log(v.OperatorVehicleId+" position="+v.transform.position+" sleeping="+v.VehicleBody.IsSleeping()+" kinematic="+v.VehicleBody.isKinematic+" constraints="+v.VehicleBody.constraints);foreach(var box in v.GetComponentsInChildren<BoxCollider>())foreach(var other in Physics.OverlapBox(box.bounds.center,box.bounds.extents+Vector3.one*.1f)){if(other.transform.IsChildOf(v.transform))continue;Vector3 dir;float depth;if(Physics.ComputePenetration(box,box.transform.position,box.transform.rotation,other,other.transform.position,other.transform.rotation,out dir,out depth))result.Log("contact="+other.name+" id="+other.GetInstanceID()+" depth="+depth+" dir="+dir);}}foreach(var c in Object.FindObjectsByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(FindObjectsSortMode.None))result.Log(c.VehicleId+" status="+c.Status+" mission="+c.MissionResult+" target="+c.LastTargetSpeedKmh+" lane="+c.LaneErrorM);}}
